content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. Before signing, I have one minor suggestion regarding the relevant clause. - The second installment is currently scheduled 60 days after the Effective Date, which delays payment beyond a standard 30-day window. We propose updating the agreement so that the second installment is due thirty days following the first installment. Please let me know if this adjustment is acceptable. Best regards,
